text: Figure 7.21: This figure shows a typical deadlock caused by two spinlocks taken in different order by Tasks on two different cores T o avoid deadlocks it is not allowed to nest different spinlocks. Optionally if spinlocks shall be nested, a unique order has to be defined. Spinlocks can only be taken in this order whereas it is allowed to skip individual spinlocks. Cycles are not allowed within the defined order. This is illustrated in figure 7.22.
